verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's core product is a managed cloud browser service, and the evidence never says its platform source is open. Only peripheral components are shown as open: HyperAgent is described as an open-source Playwright framework, and the MCP server is published on GitHub. Missing for 10: open-source release of the core cloud platform, a named open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for any component, and independent confirmation of the repos' licensing.
